description: The diagonal bound g(n)=1+max of f_i(n) for i at most n strictly exceeds f_i(n) whenever n is at least i, and eventually strictly dominates every function in the list.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.diagonalBound_spec (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) :
  (∀ (i n : ℕ), i ≤ n → f i n < Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.diagonalBound f n) ∧
    ∀ (i : ℕ), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.EventuallyLT (f i) (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.diagonalBound f)
